reason: The landlord approved the lock repair or replacement (event-006). He then told us to use his own contractor, Dorian Wren, and not to instruct anyone else (event-011, event-016). Our selected locksmith was stood down (event-017). On 9 September the tenant said Dorian attended, agreed a new lock was needed and would return the following week, and that the lock was now worse (event-020). On 16 September the tenant says he is due today after 10:00 and she will update us (event-023). Nothing is overdue, because the visit is today and she has promised an update. A chase to the landlord or contractor would be premature, and instructing another provider would breach the landlord's instruction. Escalation is not needed, because the case is progressing and the tenant is contactable. Nothing in the case shows completion: there is no confirmation of attendance, a new lock, a working spare key or an invoice position. Closing is therefore not possible, and the case-4 completion signal at event-023 is not a completion. Priority is P2, not P0. The tenant earlier said the door could be locked by hand (event-001), but event-020 says it is now worse, and we do not know whether the door can still be secured. A lock affecting security can be P1 under policy. If the tenant reports the door cannot be secured, or the contractor does not attend today, re-judge as P1 and escalate. A follow-up is set for this afternoon to ask the tenant for the outcome.
unknowns: Whether Dorian Wren attended today and replaced the lock
Whether the door can currently be secured
Whether the spare key works after the repair
Invoice position and who pays the contractor (landlord's own contractor)
options: Wait for the tenant's update, then confirm the outcome with the tenant and landlord
If there is no visit today or the door cannot be secured, escalate as P1 to the property manager
request: The tenant reports that the front-door lock feels loose and works intermittently. The door sometimes catches before closing, although the tenant says it can currently be locked by hand. A newly cut spare key does not work. The tenant is concerned about the effect on the property's security.
unrelated_issues: Broken bedroom blind letting in light (event-021)
Door glazing the landlord previously said would be addressed (event-021)
Hot water reported as too hot (event-021). This may be a safety concern and needs its own request. Ownership and status were not confirmed to the tenant.
Landlord's complaint about contractor coordination (event-011), already noted
Skirting-board paint touch-ups agreed at the tenant's expense (event-005, event-011)
